internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency and Error Injection in Ad Service
internal.body:
At 11:31 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. Initial diagnosis identified a very high error ratio (0.98) indicating error injection as the primary fault type, supported by a high p95 latency of 1.8 seconds. Resource exhaustion was ruled out due to low CPU utilization and stable memory usage.

Actions taken included disabling the adHighCpu flag at 11:50 UTC, which was approved and executed promptly. Post-action monitoring confirmed recovery with error ratios dropping to 0.002 consistently.

The incident was resolved successfully with no ongoing impact. Further analysis and lessons learned are documented below.
